abort.already_configured: Climate Brain is already set up. Open the integration and choose Configure to change it.

user.title: Climate Brain — house
user.description: Climate Brain is the only program that should change these thermostats. It does not create a second climate entity. Occupancy must be a people/phones binary sensor — never a Tesla.

data.occupancy: Occupancy binary sensor (on = someone is home)
data.independent_zones: Each zone has its own comfort, away, Boost, and night temperatures

travel.title: Travelers (optional)
travel.description: Skip this if you only care who is home. Leave the boxes empty and press Submit. Travelers are used to start heating or cooling before you arrive. A Tesla is not a person — add cars on the next screen.

data.name: Name
data.dir: Direction sensor (state includes the word toward)

tesla.title: Tesla (optional, travel only)
tesla.description: A Tesla never counts as someone in the house. Skip this if Tesla is not in Home Assistant. Empty destination is not automatically away. A car in the driveway is inhome.

clocks.title: Clocks, vacation, and default temperatures
clocks.description: These are starting values. You can change them later on the Climate Brain entities and with Configure.
